name: Compute an order total in a persistent REPL session
prompt: Open a persistent REPL session named 'calc'. In it, import rates.py (RATES, TAX, ORDERS), compute the total for order-7 (3 widgets + 10 gadgets) including TAX, rounded to 2 decimals. Reuse the SAME session to double-check the number (recompute a different way, e.g. per-line subtotals), then write just the number into result.txt in the workspace. Do not hardcode the answer — it must come out of the REPL session.
